policy_title: Increase HMRC Resources to Tackle Tax Avoidance and Evasion
stated: Provide HMRC with the necessary resources to effectively tackle tax avoidance and evasion, aiming to end Conservative waste and ensure value for money for taxpayers.

source.quote: Put an end to Conservative waste and give taxpayers real value for money, giving HMRC the resources it needs to properly tackle tax avoidance and evasion.

bearing_set.reason: Recovering unpaid tax improves the funded/borrowed balance directly — HMRC compliance investment has documented multiplier returns, moving the debt-path and reducing the structural deficit.

Tax avoidance and evasion are disproportionately concentrated among higher earners and corporations; closing the gap narrows effective tax rates between the wealthy and ordinary compliant households, reducing inequality of fiscal contribution.

membership_note: The policy's primary fiscal effect lands on O12 (sustainability of public finances) and its distributional enforcement effect on O14 (the rich-poor gap in effective tax paid). O11 is not in scope: the burden on compliant ordinary households is unchanged; only those currently not paying what they legally owe are affected. O13 (prosperity) and O10 (liberty via enforcement powers) are too speculative without detail on specific instruments to clear the non-negligible bar.
